Does local SEO guarantee the top spot on Google?

No. Search visibility depends on competition, location, your business information, content, and other factors. Get Found Now supports your local presence with ongoing work and a monthly performance check-in.

Can you help if I already have a website?

Yes. Tell us about the current website, domain, and Google Business Profile. We’ll review the situation and explain what a move to Get Found Now would involve.

Is this paid advertising?

Get Found Now is a website and local visibility plan. Paid advertising spend is not included in the plan described here; any advertising work needs a separate discussion and scope.
